svg.aria-label: One tuning cell: M to the two antenna terminals

g.title: M: C11 left metal end, facing C10. This is the existing C10/C11/C12 junction via V107; do not probe the opposite C11 end.
A: ANT1 solder terminal, next to the printed ANT1 label.
B: ANT2 solder terminal, next to the printed ANT2 label.
